import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    team_a = data[2:2 + n]
    team_b = data[2 + n:2 + n + m]
    sa, sb = sum(team_a), sum(team_b)
    za, zb = team_a.count(0), team_b.count(0)
    # Each team can reach every total in [s+z, s+10000z]; intersect the two ranges.
    lo = max(sa + za, sb + zb)
    hi = min(sa + 10000 * za, sb + 10000 * zb)
    print(lo if lo <= hi else -1)


main()
